summary.text: John Drinkwater is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 17th Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
He won the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary over Harini Aiyer and Anthony Leite, and no Republican appeared on the primary ballot.

paragraphs.text: Drinkwater previously sought the Democratic nomination for Massachusetts State Senate, 1st Middlesex District, in 2018, finishing second in a five-candidate primary with 23.9 percent of the vote; Edward Kennedy won with 26.6 percent.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements of Drinkwater from the Massachusetts AFL-CIO, the Massachusetts American Federation of Teachers, the Massachusetts Teachers Association and the ELM Action Fund.
